reason: B is better grounded in the prior observation that an Hf-containing W-Ta-Cr-V alloy showed neither loops nor precipitates at 10 dpa, and replacing part of the low-melting Cr directly targets precipitation and fabrication concerns with a controlled, falsifiable comparison. Its proposed Hf mechanism and bulk manufacturability still require validation because the supporting five-component alloy differed broadly in composition and was studied as a film, but A is more speculative, retains all the Cr, and even misstates the negligible-hardening baseline.
